doc.title: Harry Edison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Carrying pistols on Southern tours
summary: The band all carried guns for protection but never used them.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand

blocks.x: You all carried pistols on the Southern tours or all the time?
On the Southern tours. Just for protection. But we were jeopardizing our own lives when we did that because there is a whole town, a whole police force against you down there.
You recall ever having to pull it?
Last resort, yes, we all had guns.
